title: DoC: Learning to Defer or Commit for Timely, Accurate, and Stable Conversational Diagnosis Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.29003v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Conversational diagnosis prediction requires accurate, early, and stable predictions from ongoing clinical dialogue, yet dialogue-level labels do not specify when to commit. We propose a two-phase framework for learning deferral and diagnosis decisions. First, iterative commitment-boundary estimation constructs Defer/diagnosis supervision without annotated commitment times. Second, Defer-aware supervised fine-tuning initializes a policy, refined through reinforcement learning with trajectory-level rewards for timeliness, first-commit accuracy, and post-commit stability. On EMSDialog and MediTOD, DoC commits early, achieving the highest first-commit accuracy among post-trained methods (76.7%/51.2%) and the lowest post-commit error overall (16.4%/48.3%).

translated_title: DoC：学习延迟或提交以实现及时、准确且稳定的对话式诊断预测
translated_abstract: 对话式诊断预测要求从正在进行的临床对话中做出准确、早期且稳定的预测，然而对话级标签并未指明何时应当提交预测。我们提出了一个学习延迟决策与诊断决策的两阶段框架。首先，迭代式提交边界估计在无需标注提交时间的情况下构建“延迟/诊断”监督信号；其次，通过延迟感知的监督微调初始化策略，并利用轨迹级奖励的强化学习进行优化，奖励涵盖及时性、首次提交准确率和提交后稳定性。在EMSDialog和MediTOD数据集上，DoC能够尽早提交预测，在经过后训练的方法中取得最高的首次提交准确率（76.7%/51.2%），并拥有总体最低的提交后错误率（16.4%/48.3%）。
tldr: 该论文提出两阶段框架DoC，通过迭代提交边界估计与延迟感知的强化学习，使模型学会在适当时机延迟或提交诊断预测，无需提交时间标注即可实现更及时、准确且稳定的对话式诊断预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DoC, a two-phase framework combining iterative commitment-boundary estimation and defer-aware reinforcement learning that teaches models when to defer or commit, enabling timely, accurate, and stable conversational diagnosis prediction without annotated commitment times.
